map.延伸率和收缩率哪个更说明塑性？: Which indicates plasticity better, elongation or reduction of area?
map.断面收缩率 ψ 对颈缩更敏感，更能反映材料真实塑性；延伸率 δ 受标距影响，需注: Reduction of area psi is more sensitive to necking and better reflects true plasticity; elongation delta depends on gauge length and must note it.
map.δ<1% 的铸铁能用吗？: Can cast iron with delta<1% be used?
map.铸铁脆性大、几乎无塑性，适合受压件；受拉件需避免，断裂前无预警，设计安全系数要足: Cast iron is brittle with almost no plasticity, suited to compression parts; avoid tension parts, it breaks without warning, so design safety factor must be sufficient.
